scientific.integrity: The primary definition and conjecture were materially inspected, a later same-line thesis was checked for possible coverage, and exact-value, semantic-index, and owned-ledger overlap searches were performed. The proof is analytic, with packaged replay of the active-set and interval calculations.
limitations: The exact computation is for the regular decagon and its affine images only.
The global extremal conjecture for M-curvature is not proved.
The primary article lacks a printed MSC line in the inspected copy; 52C17 is supported by later work in the same blocking-number research line.

title: Exact M-curvature of the regular decagon
